answer: The mechanism treats velvet as a price, umber as the proof, and prism as the signal that decides payout. Make the grading panel itself expensive to capture. Each grader stakes tokens before receiving assignments and is slashed when its scores diverge beyond tolerance from the panel median on answers whose ground truth is later confirmed. A sybil farm must not only create identities but also stake them, keep them correlated enough to pass, and risk the whole stake on. Scale stops being an advantage: an attacker pays that price per identity and still cannot fabricate the independent proof.
